implementation.input: A complete projected single-sided planar face with one simple straight-edged loop and at most one strictly nested hole, no pcurves, bounded edge and vertex counts, and mutually consistent chain/use identities.
implementation.behavior: Classifies in raw coordinates as inside, outside or boundary with explicit tolerance; validates connectivity, identities, finite endpoints, coplanarity, curve/vertex consistency, nonintersecting rings and nesting. Unsupported, invalid, ambiguous, off-plane or resource-exceeding inputs refuse without changing the output. Does not apply transform, units, ACIS containment flags, or general B-rep semantics.

independentEvidence.result: The independent decoder matches all 8 faces, 10 ordered loops, 36 oriented coedges and the identities and coordinates of their 12 distinct vertices to 1e-10; no selected coedge has a pcurve and all supporting curves are straight.
independentEvidence.kernel: Prior BRL-CAD 7.24 selected-ray observations on an OCCT-generated normalized STEP intermediary: six rim hits and hole/outside misses; source helper agrees. This is an independent geometry kernel but not an independent source-native modeler or unmodified boundary bridge.

differentialReview.head: d25f19f7c2a56ba389c925070cf4b295fa7609c5
differentialReview.method: For the same hash-bound face, independent cq-acis supplies the two ordered triangle rings. Python Fraction exact crossing arithmetic classifies 3000 deterministic bounding-box points and 3000 points near loop edges; all are more than 2e-6 from the closest boundary. The current API runs at tolerance 1e-6. A separate scratch probe swaps source x and z in vertices, edges and planes to put the same source-derived face in a vertical plane and repeats eight peer rays, a boundary, pcurve refusal and corrected retry.
differentialReview.result: PASS; no mismatches. Rotated probe PASS.
differentialReview.limits: Selected source-derived geometry and finite points only. The rotated data is a coordinate transformation, not an additional producer witness; no new trim or consumer support claim.

budgetTestCorrection.finding: The original edge-budget negative test first failed the separate face-loop-chain consistency check, so it did not prove the 128-edge cap.
budgetTestCorrection.correctedControl: A complete generated 129-edge simple ring refuses with the result unchanged; after clearing and rebuilding as a complete 128-edge ring, the same face and output result classify the center as Inside.
budgetTestCorrection.limit: The supporting libdxfrw implementation is unchanged; native CI qualification must be rebound because the selected regression test is part of the implementation digest.

discriminatingControl.method: Compile a scratch-only copy of the classifier with the two numeric edge caps changed from 128 to 129; leave the test unchanged. The control expects exactly one failing assertion and exits zero only for that result.
discriminatingControl.result: PASS: only the 129-edge refusal assertion fails with the raised cap; the 128-edge success and all other controls remain passing. This demonstrates that the generated 129-edge input reaches the cap rather than an unrelated rejection.
discriminatingControl.limit: Scratch fault injection, no production code or fixture modified.

limitations: This closes P7-G only for the selected source-associated straight-planar boundary utility profile, not DWG 3D output, native producer/consumer support, arbitrary polygon robustness, native kernel trim semantics, curves, pcurves, multiple holes, or general ACIS support.
